message.content: {"note_claim": "The UK plans to transfer sovereignty of the Chagos Islands to Mauritius while securing a 148-year lease for the continued operation of the US military base on Diego Garcia.", "label": "PARTIAL", "quote": "Under the deal agreed in May last year, the UK would hand over sovereignty of the islands to Mauritius, while retaining control of the military base on Diego Garcia. parsed.note_claim: The UK plans to transfer sovereignty of the Chagos Islands to Mauritius while securing a 148-year lease for the continued operation of the US military base on Diego Garcia.
parsed.label: PARTIAL
parsed.quote: Under the deal agreed in May last year, the UK would hand over sovereignty of the islands to Mauritius, while retaining control of the military base on Diego Garcia. It would lease back Diego Garcia for a period of 99 years
parsed.reason: The page confirms the sovereignty transfer and the leaseback of the base, but states a 99-year lease rather than 148 years, so the specific lease length is not substantiated.
